name: Amazon monthly account keeper
why: An agent that runs the monthly routine in this kit: margins checked, restock sized and refund claims found from your reports.

name: Amazon product viability scorer
why: A second, independent score for a product idea with a go or no-go, to compare with the research skill here.

name: Star-rating review miner
why: Mines rivals' reviews by star rating for product gaps and buyer phrases, the core of review complaint mining.

name: Amazon search gap finder
why: Finds product ideas people search for that page one misses, a starting list for product research.

name: Landed cost calculator
why: Works out cost per sellable unit from a supplier quote and freight, the input every margin sheet needs.

name: Amazon fee and margin checker
why: Profit per unit after all Amazon fees, to cross-check the unit profit prompt.

name: Amazon unit profit checker
why: A quick prompt for profit per unit and break-even ad cost when you already know the fees.

name: Amazon brand registry planner
why: Plans the trademark and Brand Registry pack that A+, Vine, Brand Analytics and experiments depend on.

name: Amazon keyword picker
why: Sorts a keyword export into title, bullet and search-term phrases before the listing is written.

name: Amazon listing first draft writer
why: A fast first draft of title, bullets and search terms to run through the listing rule check.

name: Amazon launch week planner
why: A dated pre-launch and launch-day plan with honest review steps, for the first weeks of the 90-day plan.

name: Amazon PPC launch builder
why: Builds the first automatic, keyword and competitor campaigns with bids and negatives for a launch.

name: Amazon inbound stock planner
why: Sizes how much stock to send and when, to avoid stock-outs and low-inventory-level fees.

name: Amazon reimbursement claim finder
why: Scans shipment and fee reports for claims to file, alongside the claim pack prompt.

name: Supplier quote request writer
why: Turns buyer complaints into a quote request a factory understands, the step after finding a real gap.
